svg.aria-label: Libraries I contribute to, and who uses them. 385M npm downloads a week combined. Effect, 67.6M a week, used by Cloudflare, Vercel, OpenRouter, OpenCode, T3 Code. Material UI, 14.8M a week, used by Netflix, NASA, Spotify, Amazon, Unity, Docker. React Native, 22.0M a week, used by Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, Shopify, Wix. Astro, 12.4M a week, used by Cloudflare, Microsoft, Google, IKEA, Porsche, Visa, OpenCode. Solid, 12.5M a week, used by OpenCode. React Hook Form, 65.7M a week, used by Grafana, Supabase, Cal.com, Elastic. tRPC, 8.3M a week, used by Netflix, Google, PayPal, Cal.com. Cheerio, 36.5M a week, used by Google, Microsoft, Elastic. Floating UI, 145.9M a week, used by Palantir, Microsoft, Grafana. 272 merged pull requests across 37 repositories. 92% merge rate: 272 landed and 24 declined by maintainers. PRs I withdrew, PRs maintainers took over, and PRs closed in cleanups or rewrites are not counted as declined. Security: 3 vulnerabilities reported in Effect, one high, one moderate and one low severity. Repositories by merged pull requests: Effect (108 PRs, 18k stars), T3 Code (43 PRs, 81k stars), Solid (28 PRs, 37k stars), Material UI (14 PRs, 99k stars), bat (4 PRs, 62k stars), React Native (3 PRs, 127k stars), Alchemy (3 PRs, 2.1k stars), Astro (2 PRs, 64k stars), Slate (2 PRs, 32k stars), SwiftFormat (2 PRs, 9k stars), React Hook Form (1 PR, 45k stars), tRPC (1 PR, 41k stars), Floating UI (1 PR, 33k stars), Cheerio (1 PR, 31k stars), Immer (1 PR, 29k stars), oxc (1 PR, 24k stars), e2e (1 PR, 14k stars), Rolldown (1 PR, 14k stars), TanStack Virtual (1 PR, 7.2k stars), Vite+ (1 PR, 6.7k stars). The full list is on elkamali.dev.
